'''Nif Sarjun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A [[Color/Legends|blue]]-skinned Nautolan with large black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a fluent speaker of [[Nautila/Legends|Nautila]], Sarjun was a resident of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he had a shop in the city's market where he [[Merchant/Legends|sold]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]], weapon modifications, [[Hilt/Legends|hilts]], and other relics.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nif Sarjun was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears in Anchorhead, the Republic-only city on Tatooine, as an Artifice Crew Skill Vendor. In the game, Sarjun's voice actor speaks the generic alien language that many species in ''The Old Republic'' speak, but it is assumed that Sarjun speaks Nautila because he is a Nautolan.<ref name="TOR" /> Sarjun is also mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
